_what: Tier 2 of the supplier seed backfill: the 64 companies named on exactly 2 clinical NHS Supply Chain frameworks and held in no Hub supplier section. Source list: Product-Build/market-intelligence/SEED-BACKFILL-WORKLIST.md, generated by reconcile_suppliers.py after tier 1 landed.
_rule: Companies House was searched by name for each. A NAME SEARCH IS NOT A CONFIRMATION - per docs/COMPANY-REPORT-METHOD.md a company number is only 'confirmed' via route 1 (an anchored number curated into the record) or route 2 (the number the company publishes on its own site). So no number here is written to `companyNumber`. Where the registered name matches exactly and the company is active, the result is recorded as a CANDIDATE, carrying its own status and date, for confirm_company_numbers.py to prove or discard later. The verified fact in every record created from this file is the framework award, nothing else.

_verdicts.candidate: Registered name matches the awarded name exactly and the company is active. Recorded as a candidate number, never as a confirmed one.
_verdicts.probable: A plausible single match that is not an exact name match. Recorded as a candidate and flagged for route 2.
_verdicts.unresolved: No defensible match. Companies House returned nothing close, or several equally plausible companies. No number recorded. This is the correct output, not a failure.
_verdicts.foreign: Not a UK-registered company, so no Companies House record is expected to exist. Recorded with no number and a note saying so.
_verdicts.alias: Not a separate supplier - another spelling of a company already in this list. Becomes an alias, never its own record.

_howAutoResolved: Where exactly ONE Companies House company normalises to the same name as the awarded supplier AND is active, the verdict is recorded as candidate without further argument (47 of 64). Normalisation strips case, punctuation, & versus and, and legal/territory suffixes only. Every other case was decided by hand and carries its reason in `why`. Two or more equally plausible companies is never resolved by picking the first.

companies.name: AJ Mobility Ltd
companies.why: Companies House has AJ MOBILITY & TRAINING SERVICES LIMITED, AJ GLOBAL MOBILITY LTD and a dissolved AJ'S HEALTHCARE & MOBILITY LTD. Three different businesses sharing two common words is not a match.

companies.name: Biotechnics Ltd
companies.why: Only ECO BIOTECHNICS, ECO-MIST BIOTECHNICS and LANSDOWNE BIOTECHNICS exist, all unrelated. The brief also writes this supplier as 'Bio Technics Ltd' elsewhere, so the registered name may differ again.

companies.name: BMS Critical Care Ltd
companies.registered: B M S CRITICAL CARE LIMITED
companies.why: Registered as B M S CRITICAL CARE LIMITED with the initials spaced. Same company; the spacing is a 1984 filing convention.

companies.name: Braun and Company Limited
companies.why: Companies House returns only Braunstone and Braunton entities matching on the first six letters. Do NOT assume this is B. Braun — that is a different, much larger company, and guessing it would attribute framework awards to the wrong supplier.

companies.name: Bunzl Retail & Healthcare Supplies Ltd
companies.why: BUNZL RETAIL & HEALTHCARE SUPPLIES LIMITED (NF004224) is an exact name match but its status is not active, and BUNZL RETAIL SUPPLIES HOLDINGS LIMITED is dissolved. The awarded entity appears to be closed. Needs checking by hand before any Bunzl record is touched — the Hub already carries a Bunzl supplier whose products are the catering arm's.

companies.name: DP Medical
companies.why: Distinct from D.P. Medical Systems Limited (02088954), which is separately named on these frameworks and has its own record.

companies.name: Empire Medical UK
companies.why: Resolves to the same registered company (10361903) as 'Empire Medical UK Ltd', which the brief also names. One business, two spellings.

companies.name: GB UK Ltd
companies.why: Registered as GBUK LTD, without the space. GB UK SYSTEMS LTD is a separate active company, so the space is not decisive on its own. Confirm by route 2 before asserting.

companies.name: Gemini Surgical UK
companies.why: GEMINI SURGICAL INNOVATIONS (U.K.) LIMITED was dissolved in 2016; the other Gemini companies are unrelated. If the supplier is still trading it is under a name Companies House does not return for this query.

companies.name: Healthcare Supply Solutions Limited
companies.why: No company of this name. The hits are generic healthcare-supply companies matching on common words, one of them dissolved.

companies.name: IGEA S.p.A. Branch UK
companies.why: An Italian S.p.A. trading through a UK establishment. Companies House holds it as FC029969 (overseas company) and BR014963 (UK establishment), which are registrations of a foreign company, not a UK-incorporated one. Recorded here without a number so it is never treated as a UK company; the two references are noted for whoever needs them.

companies.name: Ingles Ltd
companies.why: Every hit is an accountancy or advisory firm. No medical company of this name.

companies.name: J & M Medical
companies.why: J&M MEDICAL LTD was dissolved in 2013. J&M MEDICAL NE LTD is active but is a different entity with a regional suffix, and assuming succession between them would be a guess.

companies.name: Marshall Products
companies.why: MARSHALL PRODUCTS LIMITED was dissolved in 2013. MARSHALL AIRWAY PRODUCTS LIMITED is active but differently named. Marshall Products trades as a medical distributor, so the registered entity is likely a third name this query does not return.

companies.name: Medical Devices Technology Inter Ltd
companies.why: 'Inter' in the brief is a truncation of 'International'; MEDICAL DEVICES TECHNOLOGY INTERNATIONAL LIMITED is active and the only plausible match. Held at probable because the truncation is the brief's, not the company's.

companies.name: Meditech Systems Ltd (Dorset)
companies.why: '(Dorset)' is NHS Supply Chain disambiguating this supplier from another, not part of the name. Kept in the aliases so the brief's own form stays searchable.

companies.name: Medray
companies.why: Resolves to the same registered company (12377268) as 'Medray (UK) Limited', which the brief also names. One business, two spellings.

companies.name: Omnimedical Ltd
companies.why: OMNIMEDICAL LIMITED (04850088) is an exact name match but is IN LIQUIDATION. Recording it would put a company that is not trading in front of reps as a live supplier - the NRS Healthcare failure. No number recorded, and the liquidation is the thing to check before this record is completed.

companies.name: P3 Medical Ltd
companies.why: The operating company, incorporated 1972. P3 MEDICAL GROUP LIMITED (05489687) is the holding company and is not the awarded entity.

companies.name: Saraco Industries
companies.why: SARACO INDUSTRIES HOLDINGS LIMITED is the parent and is not the awarded entity.

companies.name: Sheffmed Limited
companies.why: SHEFFMED HOLDINGS LIMITED is the parent and is not the awarded entity.

companies.name: Synapse Medical
companies.why: The brief names this supplier in full elsewhere as 'Uniphar Medtech T/A Synapse Medical', so Synapse Medical is a trading name, not a separate supplier. The three registered Synapse companies Companies House returns are unrelated to it.

companies.name: Uniphar Medtech T/A Synapse Medical
companies.why: UNIPHAR MEDTECH UK LIMITED is the trading entity; UNIPHAR MEDTECH HOLDINGS UK LIMITED (NI040976) is its parent. Both are Northern Ireland registrations. Held at probable because the brief names the trading style, not the registered entity, so which of the two holds the award is not established.
